title: Stealth Apart, Harm Together: Skill Cascading Attacks on Skill-Based Agent Systems
description:
arXiv:2609.30383v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A skill is a modular package of natural-language instructions, executable scripts, and reference resources that an agent can load at runtime to extend its capabilities for a specific task. Skill-based agent systems therefore enable flexible reuse of third-party capabilities, but the openness of this skill ecosystem also opens up a new attack surface.
